text:
INT. CONSERVATORY - EVENING

Rain needles the glass. An ORCHID leans toward the only dry pane. RUTH clips a dead root. TOM waits with a wet coat.

RUTH
You tracked mud to the orchid again.

TOM
I tracked a letter. The mud came free.

He sets a sealed envelope under the pot. Ruth does not open it. She turns the orchid toward him instead.

RUTH
If it's money, leave. If it's names, stay and get dirt on your knees.

Tom kneels. The orchid's shadow cuts his face in half.
